a: Bernoulli is a single yes/no trial with success probability p.
Binomial counts successes in n independent Bernoulli trials.
Poisson models counts of rare events in a fixed interval with rate λ.
Exponential models waiting times between Poisson events.
Uniform assigns equal probability over an interval or discrete set.
Gaussian/Normal is the bell curve fully specified by mean and variance.
P(A) = Σ P(A|B_i)P(B_i) for a partition {B_i}.
Cov(X,Y) measures joint variation; positive means they tend to move together.
For nonnegative X, P(X ≥ a) ≤ E[X]/a for a > 0.
